description: Search active listings on Bettan, newest first. All filters are optional. Returns compact results; use get_listing for the full description. When more match, the result has `next`: pass it as `after` (with the same filters) for the next page.

after.description: The `next` value from an earlier result with the same filters, for the next page.

countries.description: ISO country codes to search in. Leave out to search all countries.

currency.description: Currency of minPrice and maxPrice. Defaults to the one the countries share. Listings in other currencies are left out when a price filter is set.

query.description: Words to look for in the title and description, e.g. "road bike".

name: search_listings
title: Search listings
